body:
gittoc moved its authoritative repository from codeberg.org/dpiegdon/gittoc to
github.com/dpiegdon/gittoc (upstream commit 22fd7b0, "switch authoritative repository to github").

Two things: the root README's attribution link still points at codeberg, and the vendored copy at
.agents/skills/gittoc/ is one file behind main — its own README.md still gives the codeberg clone
URL and lists GitHub as a mirror. Everything else in the vendored copy already matches upstream
main byte for byte, and the version is unchanged at 0.8.0, so this is a link resync, not a tool
upgrade: no CLI behaviour or tracker data format changes.

Left deliberately unvendored, as before: upstream's own dev tooling and repo files (.isort.cfg,
AGENTS.md, scripts/dev/check, scripts/dev/requirements.txt, assets/gittoc_logo.png). AGENTS.md
especially — a second AGENTS.md inside this repo would be read as instructions for work here.
title: The gittoc link points at the new GitHub upstream, and the vendored copy is resynced to main
